en: The KidBox app (for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and web) requires acceptance of these Terms. This document governs the relationship between the user and the provider, defining rights and obligations.
The provider's address and other contact details are shown on the app's page on Google Play and the App Store.
Downloading, installing and using the app constitutes automatic acceptance of these Terms and the Privacy Policy. Continued use after any modifications constitutes acceptance of the updated versions.
Family management: calendar, to-do lists, routines, notes
Children's health tracking: visits, medications, vaccines, growth
Access requires an email address, Apple ID, Google or Facebook account. The user is responsible for the security of their credentials and must contact support in case of unauthorized access.
Profiles of children and other family members are created and managed by an adult, who declares to have the authority to enter their data.

The content entered by the user (photos, documents, messages, notes and other data) remains theirs. The user grants KidBox only the permission, limited to operating the service, to store it, sync it across their devices and make it visible to the family members they choose. The user is responsible for the content they upload, which must not violate the law or the rights of others.
5 GB · 30 AI messages a day, up to 100 a month · or €39.99 a year
20 GB · 100 AI messages a day, up to 200 a month · or €79.99 a year
The prices shown are list prices, in euros. The final price, including taxes and in your country's currency, is the one shown in the store at the time of purchase.

Pro and Max subscriptions, monthly or yearly, are purchased in the app through your device's store: the App Store (iPhone, iPad, Mac) or Google Play (Android). Payment is charged by the store when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period, at the same price, until it is cancelled.

You can cancel at any time from the store's subscription settings (on Google Play: Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions; on the App Store: Settings → your name → Subscriptions), before the renewal date (on the App Store at least 24 hours before). Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid, and the plan stays active until then.

Pro trial. The owner of a family who has never used it can start a free 14-day trial of the Pro plan from the app, once per person. It does not require a payment card and does not renew: when it ends, the family returns to the Free plan. It includes a limited number of AI messages.

Refunds and withdrawal. Payment, refunds and withdrawal for purchases made through the store are handled by the store itself under its own terms: refund requests must be sent to the App Store or Google Play. The rights that the law grants to consumers remain unaffected, including the right of withdrawal where it applies. For any problem with a charge you can also write to us at the address given under Contact.
Use your own content with the relevant consent
Do not share minors' data without adequate authorization
KidBox may suspend or close an account that violates these Terms or the law, notifying the user where possible. The user can stop using KidBox and delete their account at any time.

The AI is provided by Anthropic PBC. AI responses are general information and do not constitute medical, legal or professional advice. KidBox advises against making important decisions based solely on these responses.
KidBox is not a medical device and does not replace your doctor or paediatrician. In an emergency, contact the emergency services (112 in Europe).

The account can be deleted at any time from the app via Profile → Delete account. The operation removes all data permanently and irreversibly. Deleting the account does not by itself cancel a subscription bought on the App Store or Google Play: it must also be cancelled in the store.

The service is provided with reasonable care, but it may contain errors or interruptions. To the extent permitted by law, KidBox disclaims any liability for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the service. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence, for death or personal injury, or the mandatory rights of consumers, including the legal guarantee of conformity of digital content and digital services.

These Terms are governed by Italian law. If you are a consumer, the mandatory consumer protection rules of your country of residence still apply and you may bring proceedings before the courts of the place where you live (in Italy, the consumer's local court). Before going to court, write to us: we will try to find an amicable solution.
Updates are published on this page with the relevant date. Material changes result in in-app notifications. Anyone who does not accept the changes can stop using the app and delete their account.
KidBox collects personal data including contacts, location, health data and device identifiers. For the full information notice please see our Privacy Policy.

La cuenta puede eliminarse en cualquier momento desde la app en Perfil → Eliminar cuenta. La operación borra todos los datos de forma permanente e irreversible. Eliminar la cuenta no cancela por sí solo la suscripción comprada en App Store o Google Play: también hay que cancelarla en la tienda.

Si eres consumidor, siguen aplicándose las normas imperativas de protección de los consumidores de tu país de residencia y puedes acudir a los tribunales del lugar donde resides (en Italia, el foro del consumidor). Antes de acudir a un tribunal, escríbenos: intentaremos encontrar una solución amistosa.

Las actualizaciones se publican en esta página con la fecha correspondiente. Los cambios sustanciales se notifican dentro de la app. Quien no acepte los cambios puede dejar de usar la app y eliminar su cuenta.
